newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs extend losses toward close, end at day"s low.
newsitem.headline: JGBs extend losses toward close, end at day"s low.

text.p: The benchmark March Japanese government bond futures contract ended at the day"s low on Friday, pressured by book-squaring sales which emerged just before the close.
"There were no fresh factors. March was pushed down toward the close by book squaring," a trader for a city bank"s securities unit said.
JGBs were stuck in negative territory for much of the day due to firmness in Tokyo share prices and the yen"s weakness against the dollar, a trader for a major brokerage house said.
